News

Papers, talks, posters and other updates, newest first.

2026

  • Oct 2026SleepFM-2, a sleep foundation model trained on two million hours of polysomnography, was accepted at the GenAI4Health workshop at NeurIPS 2026.
  • Sep 2026Our paper on mechanistic interpretability of EEG foundation models via sparse autoencoders was accepted at NeurIPS 2026.
  • Jul 2026New preprint: real-time EEG cap electrode detection for guided point-of-care placement.
  • May 2026Talk with Magnus Guldberg Pedersen at IDA Driving AI 2026 on self-supervised learning for point-of-care EEG.
  • May 2026Two preprints: pretraining on sleep data and the clinical feasibility of smartphone-based EEG in Kenya.
  • Apr 2026Poster on smartphone-based EEG across hospitals in Kenya at the AAN Annual Meeting in Chicago, with Northwestern University.
  • Mar 2026Poster on automated EEG screening in shadow operation in Kenya at the 4th International Conference on AI in Epilepsy in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
